A little nutrition knowledge can be helpful in guiding the planning of 
balanced, satisfying meals, but a head full of nutrition rules and regulations 
could lead to a life of yo-yo dieting. Giving oneself full permission to enjoy

sary to get the client comfortable with enjoying feared foods in moderation.
Mindful Eating
You can also help your clients by teaching them how to slow down the eat-
ing experience and to savor preferred foods. Eating mindfully takes prac-
tice. Each time your client pauses to check in with her cravings and body 
signals is a small victory on the path toward developing a healthy relation-
ship with food
